dog.description_text:
Some cats wear their hearts on their sleeves, but Gavin wears his on his adorable black heart-shaped nose. Calm, thoughtful, and quietly charming, he has a gentle presence that makes him easy to love.

Gavin’s early life was challenging. He was rescued from a hoarding situation with nearly ninety cats, a place where love and attention were scarce. He spent time at the Town of Hempstead Animal Shelter, unsure of what the future would hold. In 2022, ARF Hamptons stepped in to give him and his best friend, Mila, with her stunning heterochromia, a rare condition found in only about 1% of cats that gives her one blue eye and one green eye, a second chance. A year later, they were adopted together, only to return just over two years later when their owner could no longer care for them. Since July 2025, this resilient duo has been patiently waiting at ARF, hoping to find a forever home where they can stay together and continue to thrive.

Gavin is a quiet, friendly boy who loves lounging in sunny spots and can often be found snuggling with and grooming Mila, showing the deep bond they share. He is ready to share his heart and his heart-shaped nose with someone special, ideally alongside Mila and her rare, captivating eyes.
